Preface of the book

Layman Huynh Hiep is a young Vietnamese pharmacist, currently living in Sacramento, California State Capital, USA, and is a lay disciple of the late Venerable Master Tuyen Hoa at the City of Ten Thousand Buddhas. I always have a wish towards Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva as well as wanting to establish a Ksitigarbha project to help those who have an affinity with Him through books or images.

At the end of 2007, when I was in retreat for the 5th time in Australia, Huynh Hiep asked me to translate the Japanese version into Vietnamese of the spiritual stories of Ksitigarbha without the head in Fuchu, Hiroshima. So I started working again and after more than 4 months, the translation was completed in the United States in April 2008 with nearly 900 typewritten pages, divided into 3 volumes. At first, I only posted it on the website quangduc.com in Australia and viengiac.de in Germany, but many people wanted to read the book, so Huynh Hiep once again lobbied the Taiwan Tinh Tong Hoc Association in the US to have this book published in Taiwan. In October 2010, the Buddha-Education Kim Hoi of the Tinh Tong Hoc Association in Taiwan published 1,500 copies. Each set has 3 books, until now (2012) there are no more sets left. Therefore, Vietnamese Buddhists in Southern and Northern California in the United States want to republish the first edition and I have also written a preface for this republishing. Now, Huynh Hiep wants me to edit the book "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Record of Inspiration", the Chinese version translated by Mr. Lieu Nguyen and I also started working during this 2012 Summer Retreat season. He is Chinese, his Chinese is very good, but in Vietnamese, the ideas and lyrics need to be completely revised. But thanks to this, I learned many more stories of inspiration and cause and effect through the manifestation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in China from the Tang Dynasty until now. It is truly a rare and wonderful thing.

The true stories told by the author are so vivid that anyone who reads these stories is no different from the stories of Ksitigarbha in Fuchu, Japan.

Although Dao Huu Dieu Hai in Canada tried to type according to Mr. Lieu Nguyen's translation, there are still many places where the meaning and words are still unclear. Therefore, I asked Venerable Thich Nu Chon Toan to review everything and type in any errors. It is true that the Nun also has a predestined relationship with Ksitigarbha. Four years ago, she also helped type the book about Ksitigarbha that I translated from Japanese into Vietnamese. Now Huynh Hiep wants me to write a preface for this book, in order to record the timeline as well as the translation and recording work of the ancients, leaving it for future generations and Huynh Hiep will also ask the Tinh Tong Hoc Association in Taiwan to publish it, helping Vietnamese people in all five continents have the opportunity to read the cause and effect stories and manifestations of Lord Ksitigarbha in this book to practice and to avoid evil and do good. I of course did not refuse, because this was something worth doing. Therefore, I took the pen to write these words to leave behind for future generations. In addition, Teacher Hanh Ly also helped correct spelling errors for the final time and Dao Huu Nhu Than arranged the layout of this book. Thank you very much.

Record of Records of Miracles

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, has made a profound vow, has long proven the same dharma, but has not returned to the light, has not attained Buddhahood, with great compassion spread throughout the world, manifesting according to the type of incarnation, saving sentient beings, as always in the dark place. To save sentient beings suffering in hell, using the Bodhisattva of the past to increase, make a great vow, to save sentient beings to attain Bodhi, and if the hell is not yet clean, they will not become Buddha. The nature of sentient beings is inherently good and is no different from Buddha's. Because of confusion, they are deluded and delusional in the real world. Should arise greed, anger, ignorance, create killing, religion, lust, so reincarnation in the six paths cannot escape, there is no time to escape. There are few people who are born in heaven, but many who fall into the three realms. The Bodhisattva takes pity and helps many species, hoping that he will abandon falsehood and return to the truth, so that he will not be confused and become enlightened, restoring himself to his existing Buddha nature. For example, the pearl Mani fell into the mud, foolish people considered it dirty, did not know it was a precious pearl, knowledge considered it a priceless pearl, fished it out of the mud, washed the dirty things, used the cleaned fragrant oil to hang it high, the light shone down on the sky and earth creating good rain. The mentality of sentient beings is the same. Even though they return to confusion and fall down the evil path, the inherent true nature of Buddha nature still does not contain permanence, is neither born nor destroyed, and has no changing appearance. Therefore, the Bodhisattva believes that any person whose karma is very serious, but does not have a single thought of abandoning his mind towards the suffering of sentient beings, has compassion and needs to be saved so that they can soon escape their suffering.

Layperson Ly Vien Tinh felt the Bodhisattva's compassion and compassion for the ignorance of sentient beings, so he translated the Bodhisattva's vows into plain text for dissemination, and took stories from Japan to record the inspiring stories into 18 chapters, printed them for circulation, making all sentient beings clearly know the Bodhisattva from countless eons until now. With that compassion, all sentient beings can come out of birth and death to realize Buddha nature. From there, return, respectfully make offerings, confess and recite the holy names, to become parents and escape from this world of five impurities, to be born in the upper level, to seek the Buddha's Way, to save sentient beings, to take the Bodhisattva's mind as one's mind, to take the work of being a Bodhisattva as one's own work, so as not to disappoint the Buddha's teachings, not even oneself. Holy Relics
Of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Shakyamuni Buddha once said to Universal Bodhisattva: "You should know that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva can be said to be a Bodhisattva with hundreds of thousands of billions of millions of mighty powers and beneficial deeds. The sentient beings in Jambudvipa have many karmic conditions for this Great Being. These sentient beings hear the Bodhisattva's name, see the Bodhisattva's statue, even hear a few words in the Sutra or a verse of the sutra, all of them will receive great blessings and peace, in the next life or hundreds of thousands of lives to come. are all righteous and reborn in a place of wealth and dignity.” Buddha once said to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in Jambudvipa also has many causes and conditions. If we talk about seeing and hearing the benefits of sentient beings, it cannot be exhausted in hundreds of thousands of lifetimes. "So we get to see Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva with people in this world. There is indeed a great cause and effect, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's career of saving sentient beings is no less than that of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. Buddha Shakyamuni in Dao Loi heavenly palace praised and rewarded the merits of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Make Quan Am announce it to everyone. Therefore, we know that the two Bodhisattvas have a very deep relationship with sentient beings in this land. Most people in the world know about Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva's saving lives, but very few people understand about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's teachings, and few people talk about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's saving sentient beings in hell. That was such a mistake. If we finish reading this book, we will understand that: Sentient beings who want to pray for Bodhisattvas' blessings can do so right away, without having to wait until the next life. Not to mention in the Sutras it says: "Bodhisattvas are afraid of causes, sentient beings are afraid of results." Saving results is of course necessary, but saving causes is even more urgent. People who commit ten evil deeds in this world will die in the next life and go to hell, that is the result. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva still helps those who have gone to hell, let alone those who have not yet gone to hell. Why would he not even think about it?

This Great Bodhisattva's teachings and transformations in other places are invisible to our physical eyes, so we do not understand, but in China, there are thousands of accurate and cumulative transformations of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Right in Anhui province, Cuu Hoa Mountain, in China, there are four ashrams at four famous mountains. In Putuo Mountain in the South Sea, there is Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Ngu Dai Mountain in Son Tay, there is Bodhisattva Manjushri's Ashram. Emei Mountain in Sichuan has the Bodhisattva Samantabhadra's Ashram. Nine Flowers Mountain in Anhui has the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's Dharma Place. Every July, there are countless pilgrims who come to worship Mount Hoa Son. Because July 30 is the day of Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's enlightenment. On this occasion, I would like to recount Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's vow to establish the Dharma Place. I hope we remember this carefully, we can call Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva or Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva both.

When the Buddha passed away 1,500 years ago, in the 4th year of the Tang Dynasty, in the East there was a country called Silla, which is now Korea (Korea). In the Northeast, there was a crown prince named Kim Kieu Giac. At the age of 24, he became a monk, brought a white dog named Thien Thinh, crossed the sea to China, in Anhui province, Tri Chau prefecture, Thanh Duong district, on Cuu Hoa mountain. Remaining forever on Cuu Tu Mountain, sitting in meditation for 75 years, with Son Than offering food and drink, it was not until the reign of Duong Huyen Ton Khai Nguyen on the night of July 30, the 16th year that he attained enlightenment.

At that time, at the foot of Cuu Hoa Son mountain, there was an old man who often called him Man Cong. On weekdays, he did good deeds, often offering vegetarian food to 99 monks, but there was still one monk missing to complete the number 100. Now there is a Master on the mountain, Ksitigarbha Sangha, so he wanted to invite him down the mountain to complete the number 100. This has been expected for many years. In the middle of the night of enlightenment, Son Than led him down the mountain to meet Man Cong and asked Man Cong for a piece of land the size of a robe. Man Cong said: "The land of Cuu Hoa mountain is all mine. So Bodhisattva can choose as much as he wants." At that time, the Bodhisattva took off his robe and spread it out to cover the entire Cuu Hoa mountain. Man Gong was very happy when he saw that, so he offered the entire Cuu Hoa mountain to the Bodhisattva. He also told his son to become a monk, that is, Venerable Minh Dao. Later, Man Cong also became a monk. Because I later became a monk, I had to worship my son, Master. In the statue of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva on the left, there is a young monk, Venerable Minh Dao, on the right, an old man, Man Gong. The white dog is Thien Thinh, 20 years after the Bodhisattva entered samadhi, in the second year of Chinh Duc year, on July 30, he became a saint and built a tower. From then on, Nine Flowers Mountain in Anhui province became the great Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha. If we talk about the Bodhisattva saving sentient beings, as the Buddha said, hundreds of thousands of lifetimes cannot be counted. As the above paragraph said, the story of the country in the East is true. In books such as the Tale of the God of Monks, the Tale of the High Monk, the Tale of the Layman, the Nine Flowers Mountain, etc. All these things are recorded.

Cause and Effect in the Past

By Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Why does Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's wish to save sentient beings exist? Once we know the Bodhisattva's past lives and causes, we can understand clearly. Bodhisattva's past life was once the son of a wealthy man, once the daughter of a Brahmin, once a King, and once a Holy Maiden of Light. All are clearly recorded in the original prayer book Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra. Now let's talk about two things, one is the son of a rich man, the other is the daughter of a Brahmin.

First of all, we talk about the very ancient past, when a Buddha named Lion Phan Tan with full Van Hanh Tathagata was born. At that time Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was still an ordinary person, the son of a wealthy man. He saw that the Buddha's appearance was very dignified and upright, his heart was very happy, so he went to worship Buddha Tathagata and asked: Why does Buddha have such a good appearance? Buddha replied: "If you want to cultivate and have such a good appearance, you need to make a great vow, you must forever transcend all suffering of living beings to be able to achieve it." The rich man's son immediately swore before the Buddha: "From now on, if there are sentient beings in the six paths who suffer, I must find a way to save them and become a Buddha, and then I will become a Buddha. If in this world there is still the six paths of reincarnation or the three evil paths, then I will still be a Bodhisattva to save sentient beings. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, in front of the Lion Buddha, with full effort, Van Hanh made a vow until now, not knowing that he had already done so. I have passed through countless great eons, I have transcended countless sentient beings, so I am still a Bodhisattva and have not yet become a Buddha.

I'm talking about a very long time ago, when a Buddha named Enlightenment, Concentration of Self-Satisfaction, King Tathagata appeared in the world. At that time, there was a Brahman Saint who believed in Buddhism very much, but on the contrary, the Saint's Mother did not believe in Buddhism and even slandered the Three Jewels. Therefore, when you die, you must go to hell. The saint knew that her mother would suffer a lot after her death. Therefore, he sold all his assets to do many Buddhist works, repairing the Giac Hoa Dinh Tu Tu Tathagata pagoda and tower. One day, with sincere intention, I felt the Buddha's spirit. Suddenly I heard a voice echoing from above: "If you want to know how Mother appears, go home and recite Buddha's name and you will understand." The saint returned home, so she sat solemnly and single-mindedly recited the holy name of Lord Tathagata, who read for a day and a night, suddenly felt that she had come to a beach, the water in the sea was boiling, there were many people going in and out of there, being beaten and torn apart by demons and poisonous beasts, suffering all kinds of things, so miserable that I really didn't dare to look. The holy woman wholeheartedly recited Buddha's name, so she was not frightened at all. At that time, a Demon King came to greet him, and the Saint asked: "Where is this?". The Demon King replied: "This is the coast of hell". People in the world commit killing, stealing, adultery, lying, arguing, cursing, and committing many sins. If you die after 49 days and still have no one to pray for blessings and repent, you must go to this sea. In the East, there is a sea that is even more miserable than this sea. There is another sea in the East Sea that is even more miserable. Through three layers of karma, you will reach hell, which is even more miserable." The saint asked again: "Where is my mother now?", and told her name and date of birth and death. After examining the demon king, he replied: "When your mother first came, she had to suffer in hell, but because of a son who was filial and sought blessings, three days ago she was born in Heaven." At that time, the Saint woke up as if from a dream, knew that her mother had been transcended, and took the great vow in front of the tower of the Buddha of Self-Enlightenment King Tathagata. Vow: "In the future, all sentient beings in the three evil paths are guilty, I vow to completely save them and let them become Buddhas before I can attain Bodhi. If the sinners' hell is not over, I swear I will not become a Buddha." Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva is still a Bodhisattva to this day.

We have learned about Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha's past conditions. We should also understand that Bodhisattva in the past made a great vow to save all the suffering of sentient beings and live happily with them. All sentient beings must be saved and then become Buddhas. Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's incarnations fill the entire world. Each world incarnates into tens of thousands of millions, each body contains hundreds of thousands of millions of people, leading to the Three Jewels. Forever leaving the suffering of birth and death, arriving at a place of happiness. Therefore, every time we read the title of Bodhisattva, we often call it Namo Great Vow Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Because Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra records: Sakyamuni Buddha in Dao Loi Thien Palace rubbed Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's head, praising Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's immeasurable divine power. Compassion is beyond measure, wisdom is beyond measure, eloquence is also beyond measure, causing the Buddhas of ten thousand eons to praise him endlessly.

The Buddha even kindly told the story to the heavenly beings who were in a burning house and had not yet escaped the Three Realms. Advise Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, if there are heavenly people who have even a little good root in the Buddha Dharma, they should be blessed and educated to help them grow and not let them escape. If one falls into the evil realm, one can recite a good sentence or the name of a Bodhisattva, or one verse of a Sutra from the Mahayana Sutras. One must also use divine power to save and manifest all kinds of manifestations, so as not to fall into hell, and make Heavenly beings enjoy happiness and joy. We can see Tathagata's heart to help sentient beings just like Parents love their children. Understanding the suffering of his children, he tried every way to cure them. Even though he had to suffer, he did not complain. When he was about to die, he was afraid that his children would lose their support. He tried to find relatives or friends and solemnly entrusted them to them so that they could die without repentance. We read the Ksitigarbha Sutra, and when we get to the part that the Buddha entrusted, we realize that we sentient beings are very grateful to the Buddha. Until today, we have created bad karma, so we suffer the consequences of suffering. But Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva always helps us, always guides us, but unfortunately our eyes have not yet opened, we cannot see the Great Man's face, we cannot hear the Great Man's teachings, but the Great Man saves us from life and death. Living beings receive help without knowing it, just like light shines everywhere, but blind people do not enjoy that benefit because they cannot see. How painful! Buddha Shakyamuni is infinitely compassionate. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva was entrusted by the Buddha to demonstrate endless compassion. We just hope that everyone of us will quickly stop doing evil deeds, cultivate goodness, respect the Three Jewels, and naturally be blessed by Buddha and Bodhisattvas.

Merit and Benefits
Of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva

Earth Store Bodhisattva, although he has a great karma with sentient beings in the world, has such a great karma, so what merit and benefit will he gain by making offerings to Bodhisattva? In the chapters in Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Original Vows, the chapter on the Matching Karma of Sentient Beings, the Praise of the Tathagata, the chapter on the Dharma Protector of the Earth Spirit, the chapter on Knowledge and Benefits, and the chapter on Wishing the Fall of Heavenly Humans are all very clearly narrated. Now let's briefly recall it.

If any sentient being, upon hearing the name of the Bodhisattva, clasps his hands or praises, respects or admires him, then that person will transcend 30 lifetimes of sins. If any living being draws an image of a Bodhisattva, or casts or engraves an image of a Bodhisattva in gold, silver, bronze, or stone, and then admires and worships it once, then that person will be reborn a hundred times in heaven 33 and forever leave the evil path. If you are a woman who is tired of being a girl and devotedly worships the Bodhisattva image for the rest of your life, then in your next life you will escape being a girl. If any living being sings and praises in front of Bodhisattva or Buddha statues, plays music, sings songs, then uses incense and flowers to make offerings or urges one or more people to follow, then right now and in the future they will be blessed by good gods and that person will forever be free from all hardships and unexpected calamities.

If there is a sentient being who is paralyzed in a hospital bed, wishing for life and death is not possible, and there are people who dream of demons entering the house at night, or go on dangerous roads to play with demons, then after a long time they become sick and lie miserable at night, sad and miserable. I came today to try to find you and tell you a few stories." I asked: "Master, how did you recognize me?" The old monk replied: "I have magical powers so I have known you for a long time." I noticed the blue hat of the very special old monk. The old monk immediately said: "That is an ancient hat. This year I am over 100 years old." I then pulled out a chair and invited him to sit. He refused to sit. I poured him some water. He also refused to drink, and only said: "Amitabha Buddha! You are a person with good roots and have a relationship with Buddha. Only after you were 40 years old did you see the need to study Buddhism. Only then did you understand what I said." I asked: "How does Master know about my life?" The old monk replied: "I know everything in your heart. I also know everything about your past life. I also know about your three previous lives. I will tell you. I hope that in the future you will cultivate well and be better than your previous life. In any case, you will have better achievements. I see that your heart is currently skeptical. I advise you not to doubt, because I have supernatural powers so I can understand."

At that time, I saw that Mr. Tang's appearance was very dignified. Suddenly came here and talked about many things, and kept saying that he had magical powers. I didn't understand what magical powers were, I really had doubts in my heart, I was still thinking, everything was understood by old man Tang. I really don't know what Buddha is. My mother and mother-in-law both believe in Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, so I also believe in Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva. The old monk talked about what Buddha is and what Bodhisattva is. Now I tell you the truth. For example, he is Chau Bang Dao, a director of education at the Ministry of Education. Whatever his appearance and personality, I told her and she believed immediately." I asked: "Master, how did you know him?" Old Monk said: "I told you that I have magical powers, I want to see him anytime." Ton and Hua, two workers standing next to him, said: "He has a lot of friends, and many rumors, who doesn't know!" Old Monk said: "If that's the case, then children probably won't have many friends or gossip, so I'll talk about children. Her fourth child's name is Xuan De, who lives next door, I don't need to say, the eldest child is Xuan Canh, the second child is Xuan Phuc, the third child is Xuan Quy, they all go to Primary School in Lien Hoa Kieu, their appearance and character are needless to say, isn't that right? Now you can believe it. She is a kind, dutiful mother, filial to her parents and parents-in-law. In her previous life, Binh had a special predestined relationship with her mother-in-law, so she was very filial to her. For humanity, filial piety is very important, being filial to your parents is a very precious thing in life.

At that time, my fifth child named Xuan Duong was still pregnant. The birth attendant saw that my belly was too big and thought there was a problem, so he refused to take charge of helping with the birth. I was very worried and felt extremely guilty. Old Monk said: "Currently you are pregnant with a boy, your bones are big so your belly is big, don't worry, there is no danger at all, on the 9th day of the 8th month, Dragon time, the baby was born, giving birth was very easy, the child did not cry at all, that's his temperament" and also said: "You gave birth to five sons and then a daughter. Actually, you were supposed to have five sons and two daughters. But you were not good at cultivating well so you only had one daughter. When the daughter was born, You will be born in trouble, but I often come to help you, don't worry about anything, there is no danger to your life. But one thing is that you must make a vow to worship the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas at the altar on Cuu Hoa mountain. It's up to you if you don't say anything. I ask if you can offer 100 kilos of lamp oil or not? If possible, make sure the whole family is safe. There will be no danger at all when giving birth to your daughter 20 maybe?” I said: "Maybe". The old monk did not write it down in his handbook, just wrote on a piece of paper "Chau Duong Tue Khanh offered 20 kg of lamp oil", then asked me to light three incense sticks and follow him to the southwest behind the garden to perform the ceremony. The old monk burned the paper and said: "The Nine Flowers Mountain already knows about this." I saw that old monk walking back and forth with his feet as light as flying without a sound. Inside I felt strange, but I didn't understand why? I asked, “How does Master know my last name?” He replied: "I have said many times that I have magical powers." I took the money and gave it to him. He did not accept, saying: "It is enough for you to offer the oil. If you bring the oil yourself, I will personally come and greet you. If you send someone to bring it, I will not come out again. You can send this person (pointing to someone with the surname Ton, saying: "This person is from Anhui district". That person will know to enter this Palace" (then wrote the name of the Palace on the paper. Unfortunately, during the resistance war, the family moved many times, so this paper was lost).

Hua Thi pouted and said: "You say you don't take money, even though it's not money?" Old Monk said: "What do you know? What was your past life? It's very pitiful, I don't want to say. Your boss is a very rare good person, so I came here to talk to her. Don't say too much. It's almost afternoon, my husband is about to go home from work. He has a hot temper, he will think of me as a Venerable monk, a Venerable who needs money, and scolds me and you no matter what. Don't be angry, I'm not angry either. He is a kind-hearted person. He was angry for a while but it was okay. Last year when he was in Shanghai, someone came and pretended to be your friend and stole some money from you. Did you really scold you? That money was owed to that person in your previous life. It's a good thing to pay him back now. You shouldn't be upset and cry anymore" (Because of this, I was very upset and cried).

When my husband was in Nanjing, he often went to the China Society Academy to visit him. He was an old layman Chau Thieu Do. He spent money to engrave Sutras, and asked Great Master Au Duong Canh Nghi Hoang to carve a stele in front of Mother's grave. In the stele, "Rotating three thousand is just a light effort. Being grateful to our Parents is a great merit. We engrave the stele to worship Mother, hoping to reach the Pure Land soon." However, he had never heard the sutras recited, did not understand the Buddha's teachings, and did not understand the meaning of the Sangha. At that time, because of the influence of the event of eliminating superstitious concepts, his thoughts were contradictory. Because that year I was deceived by people, he thought I was stupid or deceived, and when I returned home I didn't find out the details, so he got angry and scolded me for not listening and arbitrarily donating money. Most of you borrowed the Venerable's name to pretend to beg for money for profit.

The old monk smiled and said: "I know you will be angry. Don't scold me and don't scold your wife. In your previous life you cultivated well, in this life you have a good wife, in the future you will have to ask your wife to save you and help you. Amitabha Buddha: Amitabha Buddha."

The person who worked as Hua Thi sent Mr. Tang out the door. When he came back, he told me that he didn't know why he was nowhere to be seen when Mr. Tang left the door, and didn't understand what was going on? I was very sad about this because I didn't understand why, the old monk's words did not dare to tell my husband. But the monk's clothes, rosary, voice, smile, and gestures are all deeply imprinted in my brain.

At the hour of the Dragon on August 9 of that year, my fifth child was indeed born. When he was born, he was very quiet and fell asleep without a single cry. Mother and child are both safe. On January 26, when I gave birth to my child Xuan Ban, I had abdominal inflammation, the condition was serious, it took more than a month of treatment to recover, and the danger turned into safety. Everything that happened was completely consistent with what the old monk said the other day.

The resistance war was fierce, my family left Nanjing and migrated back to the countryside. In January of the 27th Republic Year (1938), my husband was ordered to take the position of principal of the Third National High School. The whole family moved from Thuy Kim to Dong Nhan Gui Chau. In the spring of his 30th year (1941), my husband transferred to Chongqing to hold the position of Advisor to the Examination Institute, and my mother and I remained in Tongren Guizhou. I often think about my mother-in-law, who passed away more than ten years ago, and I miss her very much. Every time I think about it, tears flow. I had just turned 40 years old that September, and often thought about how to repay the favor. Some people say that if you want to repay your mother-in-law, you must worship Buddha and read the Bo blood sutra. A Taoist woman came and said she would teach me to read the sutra, but I had to bow to the woman as Teacher. For some reason, I felt unsatisfied, so I procrastinated many times and refused to go to her house.

In March 31 (1944), at night I dreamed of two monks wearing robes, with shoulder-length ears, one wearing a blue shirt, entering the door, calling my name and saying: "Is the ancient rosary of the Han Dynasty, made of Arhat jade, still available?" (This rosary was given to my husband when he was in Ha Nam Sung Son in Trung Nhac Temple by the old monk). Another monk said: "Don't worry so quickly, I will introduce you later." Introduce? I don't know what you mean by introduction, but I said it politely, asking Master to pay attention.

On June 19, at Dong Nhac Temple in Dong Nhan, there was a Quan Am Hoi, suddenly someone loudly said three or four times: "Take refuge in the Three Jewels", "Take refuge in the Three Jewels" three or four times like that. Everyone hears this saying, but doesn't know who said it, and doesn't understand the meaning of Taking Refuge in the Three Jewels, they just hear the sound. After I went to ask Master Khoan Ngan for advice, I learned a little about that saying. I then asked to take refuge, but he did not agree and said: "During the resistance war, I only worried about running around, what should I take refuge in? Later, I will go to Pho Da Son to take refuge." I begged and begged. He reluctantly accepted, and said: "I really don't want you to take refuge, but suddenly there was a voice in space, I'm afraid the Bodhisattva is calling you to take refuge", and then performed a simple ritual. So I started taking refuge in the Three Jewels, and after the age of 40, I will believe in Buddha and study Buddhism. That was the experience of Master's words from many years ago that I had forgotten, but now I remember.

After taking refuge, Master Khoan Ngan taught me to read the Great Compassion Mantra. I asked him to teach me how to read the Diamond Sutra, but he refused and said: "You don't understand, why read?" One night I dreamed that an old Venerable taught me to read the Amitabha Sutra, and after reading it, I saw a boat flying by in the air. I asked in fear: "Why can a boat fly?" The Venerable said: "It is not an easy-to-see object." When I turned back, the boat and the Venerable had also disappeared, with the Amitabha Sutra still in my hand. When I woke up, even the Amitabha Sutra in my hand was no longer there. I thought carefully about the appearance and aura of this old Venerable and found many similarities with the Master I met in Nanjing. From then on I often thought of the Venerable from years ago.

The next morning, Master Khoan Ngan came and said: "On the stairs downstairs, I heard you reading the Amitabha Sutra." I recounted the story of that night dreaming about reading Amitabha Sutra. I would like to ask what is Amitabha Sutra? Luckily, he briefly explained it to me more or less. That afternoon, when he put the books out to dry, my son saw a book of Buddhist scriptures previously printed by Mr. Truong Mac Quan (those books he did not bring with him when he was in Nanjing. I don't know why there was a book of Sutras mixed in with the pile of books. That's probably a special thing). Diamond Sutra, Amitabha Sutra, Infinite Life Sutra, Heart Sutra, Great Compassion Mantra, etc., are all included. I was so happy, from then on I devoted myself to chanting Sutras and mantras, day and night non-stop, forgetting all my fatigue.

During the resistance war, my husband also made a point of reciting Ma Loi Chi Thien Sutra. The old layman Chau Thieu Do also sent a letter telling him to read the Amitabha Sutra and confess the Holy name of Guan Yin. In Dong Khanh, Mr. Dai Quy Dao was also inspired, his faith in Buddha became more and more solid, and he chose many Sutras to send to Dong Nhan for me. When he was in Jiangxi in charge of education, there was a Buddha Hall in my house, and he often came with us to worship Buddha. After arriving in Taiwan, he was introduced by the old layman Long Kien Hanh, took refuge with the Venerable Nam Hoa Hu Van, and was also an old disciple who often followed Ly Tuyet Lu, listening to the Sutras and learning Buddhism very well. That was roughly his destiny for studying Buddhism.

July 42 (1953) was the Holy Birthday of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Layperson Tuyet Lu gave my family about ten images of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. I looked at the picture of the Bodhisattva and saw that his clothes and rosary looked exactly like the 100-year-old monk from Nine Hoa Son who came to my house in Nanjing 24 years ago. The difference is that the statue's appearance is a bit younger, and in its hand is a tin Tich Truong. I thought back to his words and everything that happened proved to be true. I told my family in detail. After hearing this, my wife was shocked and said: "There are such rare relics, of course they are the reincarnation of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. Why didn't you tell me sooner, leaving me guilty until now? Because you made the Bodhisattva vow, I also know that only with concentration, single-minded and single-minded practice, is that not you who saved me and helped me? Therefore, I respectfully bow to the Buddha and wholeheartedly repent."

In December, Dai Trung Bao Thien Tu invited the Bach Saint Dharma Master to lecture on "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's Vow Sutra". The Dharma Master is the person who received The Phat at Cuu Hoa Son. When preaching the Sutra, we often talk about the story of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. The Sutras also talk about the path of worship, such as building stupas, carving images, and offering lamp oil. I thought about the past stories, according to the original report, asked if there was a Buddhist monk over 100 years old on Cuu Hoa Mountain? The Dharma Master replied: "I have been in Cuu Hoa Son for many years, and have never heard or seen any Venerable who can prove the story of 18 years ago, that his incarnation was over 100 years old." That must have been Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's incarnation. He held a thick book for her to see and saw those golden words but refused to open it for her to write. He walked away and then disappeared again. This is a kind of manifestation that is difficult to describe. Ksitigarbha often incarnates here and there at Holy Relics. Many people who live near Cuu Hoa Son receive this grace.

After asking once, it can be said that with the other general it can be compared, which means there is no longer any doubt. The eyes of ordinary people cannot recognize Saints, nor can they distinguish between Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. Therefore, ordinary people lose an opportunity that is difficult to encounter in human life, so they do not ask much about cause and effect, do not ask for advice, and may violate the dignity of the Gods and Bodhisattvas, causing sins. So it's too late to repent, and it's difficult to redeem it in a hundred lifetimes.

My family and I respectfully knelt and worshiped in front of the altar of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva at Bao Thien Temple, offering 20 kilos of clear oil, to show our sincere wishes, sincerely pray, repent for what we have done, and dedicate ourselves to the Dharma world, as well as heaven and earth. Repent for sins from the past to present, hoping to reduce karma and move towards the Dharma world.

It's been almost a year since last year's repentance and worship to the Buddha. Briefly recalling the gist of the story, I honestly tell you fellow practitioners, along with citing the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Vow Sutra, in the See-Hear-Benefits chapter of the World-Honored One, he said: "I see Ksitigarbha's majestic divine power, countless eons of time it is difficult to explain, seeing, hearing and worshiping in one thought, benefits the human world immeasurably." Question: What day is Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's holy birthday?

Answer: July 30th lower calendar date.

Question: What is the basis?

Answer: In the 4th year of Yonghui of the Tang Dynasty, in the East there was the Silla country (ie the current state of Goryeo). After becoming a monk, Crown Prince Kim Kieu Giac used a boat to go to China, to the Jiu Zhishan mountain on the Jiuhua Mountain in Anhui province, practicing for 75 years. During the reign of Tang Huyen Tong, he attained enlightenment in the 16th year on July 30, and then entered samadhi for 20 years. On July 30, Duong Chinh Duc's 2nd year, the Tang dynasty established a stupa, so Ksitigarbha's birthday is that day.

Question: Is Cuu Hoa Son the Bodhisattva's transformation ashram?

Answer: Yes, Jiuhuashan ashram is in Qingyang district, Anhui province. Every year in July, there are many people who come to make a pilgrimage to Jiuhua Mountain, and transportation is convenient (Depart from Shanghai, take a boat to Datong district, Anhui province, then take a boat to Qianjia Palace, then sit on a chair with several people carrying it to Jiuhua Mountain).

Question: Why is it that when reciting the holy name, one often calls Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Great Vow?

Answer: The two words Great Vow have a very strong origin, it is said in the Ksitigarbha Sutra. Bodhisattva in her previous life was once the daughter of a Brahmin, once the son of a wealthy man, once a Holy Maiden of Light, and once a King. When she was still a Brahmin daughter, she stood in front of the Tathagata's Tower of Enlightenment, Concentration of Self-Freedom, and made a great vow: "I vow to save all sinful sentient beings in the future, to open all means, so that they can be liberated." When he was the son of a rich man, he made a great vow in front of the Lion Phan Tan Tathagata, making a great vow: "I will until the future, regardless of my fate, for the sins and sufferings of the six paths of sentient beings, expand the means, to liberate them all, then I myself will become a Buddha." When she was the Holy Maiden of the Light Eye, she made a great vow: "I swear from now on, in front of the statue of the Pure Lotus Mu Tathagata, from now on for hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas, in all worlds. All hells and the three evil paths, all the sins and sufferings of sentient beings, I vow to save them, so that they can leave hell, evil beasts, animals, hungry ghosts, etc., just like people with crimes become Buddhas and then I can achieve Enlightenment." When he was the King, he made a great vow: "If I do not save all the sins and sufferings of sentient beings so that they can be happy and reach Bodhi, I will still not become a Buddha." Therefore, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, without knowing that he has gone through countless eons and saved countless sentient beings, is still still a Bodhisattva and has not yet become a Buddha. The Bodhisattva's vow alone cannot become a Buddha. Just think, how great is the Bodhisattva's vow! How can I say it all? Among the Great Bodhisattvas, Manjushri Bodhisattva manifests Great Wisdom, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva manifests Great Virtue, Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva manifests Great Compassion, and Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva manifests Great Vows. In the Dharma Assembly of Shakyamuni Buddha, he vows to subdue and strengthen sentient beings, and vows to escape the suffering and evil of sentient beings, which must be recognized as the Great Vow of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva.

Question: I heard that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva only saves sentient beings in hell, is that true?

Answer: In the Vow Sutra, Buddha said: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and the Jambudvipa world have great karma. If we talk about all the Knowledge and Benefits of sentient beings, hundreds of thousands of eons cannot be counted." In the Contemplation Sutra, the Buddha clearly stated: "From the time he first aroused his mind until now, through immeasurable and boundless experiences of countless A Sangha kalpas, he has saved Tat Ba Nhuoc Hai for a long time. His merit is complete, relying on the power of his own vow, his image appears in the ten directions. Although he has traveled to many lands, he has always created meritorious deeds. Staying in the five defilements and evil worlds, he has created deep benefits in his personal association, his body is dignified, his virtue is outstanding, he is only Except Tathagata, there is no one who can compare with all the karma in the world. Except for Bien Cat and Avalokiteśvara, all great Bodhisattvas cannot compare. The Bodhisattva's original vow is enough to achieve all sentient beings' wishes. Being able to destroy all serious sins of sentient beings, except all karma, will be at peace." Worldly people think that Bodhisattvas only save sentient beings in the hell realm, without thinking about the human world, which is a huge misunderstanding. In the scriptures, it is said: "Bodhisattvas are afraid of causes, sentient beings are afraid of results." Saving results is of course necessary, saving causes is even more urgent. In the human world, sentient beings commit the ten evil karmas that are the cause, and in the next life they must go to hell, that is the result. Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva for Those in hell are still saved, let alone those who have not yet gone to hell.

Question: I have heard that Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's merits and benefits surpass those of Great Bodhisattvas, is that true?

Answer: Most of the Great Bodhisattvas are reincarnated ancient Buddhas, no one is better than anyone else, but sentient beings from many lifetimes up to now often have dharma relationships that are both deep and shallow, so avoid them to avoid them. But Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva has great causes and conditions for this world, so the World-Honored One praises him as supreme, and sentient beings who have strong faith will benefit. In the Ten Rings Sutra, the Buddha said: "Suppose there is someone who believes that Maitreya Bodhisattva Miraculous Auspicious and Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is the leader of Khacāsha Mahabodhisattva and Maha Yan who in hundreds of eons wholeheartedly take refuge, recite the name, recite, recite, worship, worship all the wishes. The Great Being has long been familiar with sentient beings and has great faith in great compassion, surpassing the great Bodhisattvas. Therefore, you should make offerings." In the Original Vows Sutra, it is also said: "Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Jambudvipa has great causes and conditions like Manjushri, Samantabhadra, Avalokiteshvara, and Maitreya, and he also transforms into countless bodies to save the six paths. But that is not all, as Ksitigarbha teaches and transforms all sentient beings in the six paths, making vows for eons as many as tens of thousands of billions of thousands of thousands of thousands of lives."

Question: Does Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teach us the Dharma to practice?

Answer: Yes! Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva teaches us to recite Buddha's name and live in the age of the end of dharma. The method of reciting Buddha's name is the most certain. The Prayer Sutra calls the Buddha's title the Middle level. Of course, the names of the Buddhas are thoroughly listed. In the Ten Wheels Sutra, it is clearly stated that one will be born in the Pure Land, where the Master is. "The Contemplation Sutra also says: "If there is a person who wants to live in a foreign land, called the Pure Land, he should chant according to the name of the Buddha world, with one mind without disturbance, like the person observing above, he will definitely live in the Buddha's country. Question: I already know about Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's great vows, so why do I still see that the karma of sentient beings is still so heavy?

Answer: I have seen it clearly stated in the Prayer Sutra from Chapters 3 to 5. In it, Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva once clearly explained the cause and effect of events and the retribution of sentient beings in hell. Bodhisattva has told them about all the sins of sinners about the retribution of each sin, but they have not yet awakened and repented, so they still have to go to hell to suffer. In the hells, the most miserable is in the Infinite Hell. Because the suffering is never interrupted, the sinner's nature is also uninterrupted, and the sinner's suffering is also uninterrupted.

Question: What kinds of people deserve to go to the Hell of No Interruption?

Answer: One is those who are filial to their parents, or kill people. Second, making the Buddha's body bleed, defaming the Three Jewels, and disrespecting the Sutras. Third is to harm the permanent residents, defile the monks and nuns or commit adultery in the Gia Lam place, or kill or harm. Fourth, pretend to be a monk. In my heart, I am not a monk, destroying the permanent property, deceiving the white robe. Fifth is stealing property, rice, food and clothes, to the point of not giving it away but taking it from others. These types of people deserve to go to hell, and can hardly hope to escape.

Often advised in the chapter "Buddha's Accumulation of Humanity" "The Buddha touched the Bodhisattva's head again, praising the Bodhisattva's inconceivable power. Compassion is also inconceivable.
